purpose: Test a modality-aware candidate rule read-only against the completed Candidate Generator v2.3 retrieval artifacts and frozen reference positives.

evidence_domains.full_artifact_capacity: The 130000-image v2.3 retrieval artifacts measure candidate load without rescoring images.
evidence_domains.natural_reference: The 23 AI-assisted, non-expert same-source references are checked by actual full-index pair membership.
evidence_domains.controlled_reference: The 1040 generated-transform positives are evaluated from their saved holdout metrics because generated images are not members of the 130000-image full index.
evidence_domains.exact_reference: Every pair implied by the normalized SHA-256 duplicate manifest is explicitly unioned and checked.

interpretation_limits: Passing this counterfactual is evidence for accepting a candidate-shortlist rule, not a duplicate decision or cancer-classification result.
The 23 natural references do not prove full natural-near-duplicate recall across all possible dataset pairs.
The controlled positives reuse a known transformation suite and must be reported separately from natural evidence.
A passing report does not authorize scoring, family construction, splitting, or training without a separate explicit checkpoint.
